list_description: Lists the AIODOS knowledge libraries open to assistants (the user's documents indexed on their machine): name, number of items and of passages. Useful to limit a search to one library.
search_description: Searches by meaning in the user's documents indexed by AIODOS (PDF, Word, web pages, notes, code, transcripts…). Returns the passages closest to the question, with their source and a score from 0 to 1. Ask a precise question, in natural language.
search_question: What you are looking for, in natural language.
search_library: Name of a library to limit the search to (see lister_bibliotheques).
search_count: Maximum number of passages (5 by default).
converse_description: Gets an answer from a language model in the AIODOS circle (this machine, or a paired machine that lends its models) and returns it in full. No history: each call is independent. May take a minute.
converse_model: Name of a model (e.g. qwen3.5:9b), the machine being chosen automatically, or peer:<machine>:<model>. Defaults to the one chosen in AIODOS.
scope_missing: This application does not have the “{scope}” permission that “{tool}” requires.
library_unknown: Unknown library, turned off or kept on this PC: “{library}” (see lister_bibliotheques).
search_failed: Cannot search: the embedding model “{model}” is not responding ({error}).
count_invalid: “nombre” must be an integer from 1 to 20.
no_passage: No passage close enough to the question in the AIODOS libraries.
no_chat_model: No chat model in the AIODOS circle.
bridge_remote_url: AIODOS_MCP_URL ({url}) is not on this machine: the AIODOS key is not sent there automatically; provide it with AIODOS_KEY.
bridge_never_started: AIODOS has not been started on this machine yet.
bridge_never_opened: The AIODOS gateway has never been opened: turn it on in Settings → Other tools.
bridge_no_answer: AIODOS is not responding at {url}: start AIODOS and open the gateway (Settings → Other tools).
bridge_key_refused: Access key refused by AIODOS (Settings → Other tools).
bridge_without_p: AIODOS: MCP bridge started without -P; copy its configuration again (Settings → Other tools).
